purpose: Replace a fixed receptor count with a conservative nested stopping rule: add another receptor only when the inner-validation evidence exceeds sampling uncertainty.

adaptive_cardinality.maximum_k_reason: Stage20 already screened k=1..6 and found no stable evidence for continuing beyond k=3; Stage100 changes the stopping rule without reopening that consumed search.
adaptive_cardinality.primary_rule_definition: Find the k with the highest mean inner-fold BEDROC. Select the smallest k whose mean is at least best_mean minus the standard error of the best k.
adaptive_cardinality.secondary_rule_definition: Starting from k=1, continue to k+1 only when mean(BEDROC_{k+1}-BEDROC_k) minus one standard error is positive; stop at the first failure.
adaptive_cardinality.selector: Stage99 robust two-support BEDROC20 pair QUBO

single_shot_variable_k_formulation.marginal_rule: adding j is beneficial only if u_j-lambda_cost+eta*sum_{i in S}delta_ij is positive
single_shot_variable_k_formulation.interpretation: lambda_cost prices one additional receptor; the unconstrained QUBO stops naturally when every remaining marginal gain is nonpositive
single_shot_variable_k_formulation.execution_status: formulated but not sent to hardware; Stage100 first validates the statistically equivalent nested stopping decision

gate.failure_action: Freeze the adaptive stopping route; do not tune a stopping threshold or receptor cost on these same five matrices.
